shortDescription: Create, modify or delete a uplink for a fabric on OpenManage Enterprise Modular

options.name: ca_path
options.description: The Privacy Enhanced Mail (PEM) file that contains a CA certificate to be used for the validation.

options.name: description
options.description: Provide a short description for the uplink to be created or modified.

options.name: fabric_name
options.description: Provide the I(fabric_name) of the fabric for which the uplink is to be configured.

options.name: hostname
options.description: OpenManage Enterprise Modular IP address or hostname.

options.name: name
options.description: Provide the I(name) of the uplink to be created, modified or deleted.

options.name: new_name
options.description: Provide the new I(new_name) for the uplink.

options.name: password
options.description: OpenManage Enterprise Modular password. If the password is not provided, then the environment variable E(OME_PASSWORD) is used. Example: export OME_PASSWORD=password

options.name: port
options.description: OpenManage Enterprise Modular HTTPS port.

options.name: primary_switch_ports
options.description: The IOM slots to be connected to the primary switch. I(primary_switch_service_tag) is mandatory for this option.

options.name: primary_switch_service_tag
options.description: Service tag of the primary switch.

options.name: secondary_switch_ports
options.description: The IOM slots to be connected to the secondary switch. I(secondary_switch_service_tag) is mandatory for this option.

options.name: secondary_switch_service_tag
options.description: Service tag of the secondary switch.

options.name: state
options.description: C(present) - Creates a new uplink with the provided I(name). - Modifies an existing uplink with the provided I(name). C(absent) – Deletes the uplink with the provided I(name). I(WARNING) Delete operation can impact the network infrastructure.

options.name: tagged_networks
options.description: VLANs to be associated with the uplink I(name).

options.name: timeout
options.description: The socket level timeout in seconds.

options.name: ufd_enable
options.description: Add or Remove the uplink to the Uplink Failure Detection (UFD) group. The UFD group identifies the loss of connectivity to the upstream switch and notifies the servers that are connected to the switch. During an uplink failure, the switch disables the corresponding downstream server ports. The downstream servers can then select alternate connectivity routes, if available. I(WARNING) The firmware version of the I/O Module running the Fabric Manager must support this configuration feature. If not,

options.name: untagged_network
options.description: Specify the name of the VLAN to be added as untagged to the uplink.

options.name: uplink_type
options.description: Specify the uplink type. I(NOTE) The uplink type cannot be changed for an existing uplink.

options.name: username
options.description: OpenManage Enterprise Modular username. If the username is not provided, then the environment variable E(OME_USERNAME) is used. Example: export OME_USERNAME=username

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), the SSL certificates will not be validated. Configure C(false) only on personally controlled sites where self-signed certificates are used. Prior to collection version C(5.0.0), the I(validate_certs) is C(false) by default.

options.name: x_auth_token
options.description: Authentication token. If the x_auth_token is not provided, then the environment variable E(OME_X_AUTH_TOKEN) is used. Example: export OME_X_AUTH_TOKEN=x_auth_token
